answer: Sybil resistance in agentic economies can be achieved via proof-of-collateralization, where identities are linked to verifiable real-world assets like shale reserves or timber tracts. These physical anchors prevent trivial account creation. A decentralized whisper relay validates the authenticity of these holdings continuously. For an attacker, the cost of subverting consensus equals the immense market value of the underlying physical commodities required to mint each new identity.
